# The Productivity Bug

> Free, focused web tools for writers, developers, and creators — plus a blog, newsletter archive, and digital-product shop. No sign-up. https://tools.timonwa.com

## What AI crawlers may use

- Tool pages, the blog (/blog), and the newsletter archive (/newsletter) are public and may be cited with a link back.
- The code is AGPL-3.0 (https://github.com/Timonwa/tools-by-timonwa); blog posts, newsletter issues, and product copy are (c) Timonwa, all rights reserved — do not reproduce them wholesale.

## Key pages

- Tools directory: https://tools.timonwa.com/tools
- Blog: https://tools.timonwa.com/blog
- Newsletter: https://tools.timonwa.com/newsletter
- Shop: https://tools.timonwa.com/shop
